picks.name: Hongtu Hall (宏图府)
picks.insiderTip: Queue by 7:30 AM — no reservations for non-hotel guests. The char siu bao with abalone sauce is the signature.
picks.address: 1 Shamian Nan Jie, White Swan Hotel, Liwan District
picks.whatToOrder: Char siu bao with abalone sauce, crystal shrimp dumplings, molten custard buns, signature congee.
redditQuotes: White Swan Hotel has been serving dim sum for over 40 years, and all my local friends in Guangzhou can't stop recommending it.
Hongtu Hall is prized for its exquisitely crafted dim sum ranging from the classics to novel creations.

picks.name: Tao Tao Ju (陶陶居)
picks.insiderTip: Founded 1880. The beef rice rolls with dried tangerine peel are extraordinary — the abalone-sauce char siu bao is a must.
picks.address: Hui Fu Dong Lu, Yuexiu District
picks.whatToOrder: Beef rice rolls with dried tangerine peel, char siu bao with abalone sauce, caviar siu mai, har gow.
redditQuotes: Tao Tao Ju was founded in 1880 and still serves some of the best dim sum in Guangzhou.
The beef dishes truly stood out. The rice rolls with beef were smooth on the outside, meaty and bouncy on the inside.

picks.name: Dian Dou De (点都德)
picks.insiderTip: Multiple branches — the Huacheng Avenue location is most convenient. The red rice rolls are the must-order.
picks.address: Huacheng Avenue, Zhujiang Xincheng, Tianhe District
picks.whatToOrder: Signature red rice rolls (¥34), siu mai with whole shrimp (¥32), honey char siu bao (¥25).
redditQuotes: Dian du de is very very good. If you like sweet dim sum, you should try that yellow lau sa bao.
Everyone has their own favorite place for Cantonese dim sum in Guangzhou! Besides these classics: Dian Dou De...

picks.name: Guangzhou Restaurant (广州酒家)
picks.insiderTip: Visit the original Wenchang Nan Lu location for the classic experience. Famous for har gow and mooncakes.
picks.whatToOrder: Har gow, lotus leaf sticky rice, traditional siu mai, mooncakes.
redditQuotes: Guangzhou Restaurant AKA Guangzhou Jiujia is one of Guangzhou's oldest and most famous dim sum restaurants.

picks.name: Panxi Restaurant (泮溪酒家)
picks.insiderTip: Come for the stunning Lingnan garden as much as the dim sum. The world's largest garden-style Chinese restaurant.
picks.whatToOrder: Fried salty dumplings, steamed spare ribs, BBQ pork pastries.
redditQuotes: Panxi is the world's largest garden-style restaurant with solid dim sum in a gorgeous setting.

picks.name: Bingsheng Taste (炳胜品味)
picks.insiderTip: Open until 4 AM — great for late-night dim sum. Premium ingredients and creative presentations.
picks.whatToOrder: Crispy roast goose, creative dim sum platters, premium seafood dumplings.
redditQuotes: Bingsheng is where Guangzhou's business crowd goes for upscale dim sum and late-night Cantonese food.

picks.name: Lei Garden (利苑酒家)
picks.insiderTip: Hong Kong's Michelin-starred chain in Guangzhou. Technically refined dim sum with premium ingredients.
picks.whatToOrder: Signature baked char siu bao, steamed lobster dumplings, bamboo charcoal har gow.
redditQuotes: Lei Garden brings Hong Kong's Michelin-starred dim sum standards to Guangzhou.

picks.name: Jade River (玉堂春暖)
picks.insiderTip: Weekend-only yum cha service. The other Michelin star at White Swan Hotel, more refined than Hongtu Hall.
picks.address: 1 Shamian Nan Jie, White Swan Hotel, Liwan District
picks.whatToOrder: Premium har gow, roasted goose, signature clay pot rice, seasonal tasting menu.
redditQuotes: Jade River was the first to receive a Michelin star at the White Swan Hotel.
picks.openingHours: Sat-Sun: 8 AM - 2:30 PM (yum cha); Daily: 11:30 AM - 2:30 PM, 5:30 - 9:30 PM

picks.name: Beiyuan Cuisine (北园酒家)
picks.insiderTip: One of Guangzhou's 'Big Four' garden restaurants. Quieter than Panxi with century-old architecture.
picks.whatToOrder: Traditional har gow, siu mai, steamed spare ribs with black bean sauce, congee.
redditQuotes: Beiyuan is one of the Big Four garden restaurants of Guangzhou with solid dim sum.

picks.name: Lian Xiang Lou (莲香楼)
picks.insiderTip: Since 1889. Famous for lotus seed paste pastries. The ground floor sells iconic Cantonese pastries to go.
picks.address: 67 Di Shi Fu Lu, Liwan District
picks.whatToOrder: Lotus seed paste buns, egg tarts, traditional siu mai, and buy their famous mooncakes.
redditQuotes: Lian Xiang Lou is famous for lotus seed paste pastries — a Guangzhou institution for over a century.

picks.name: HongMian Chinese Restaurant (红棉中餐厅)
picks.insiderTip: Creative twists on classics at The Westin — truffle siu mai and lobster har gow in an upscale setting.
picks.address: 6 Linhe Zhong Lu, The Westin, Tianhe District
picks.whatToOrder: Truffle siu mai, lobster har gow, signature baked pork buns, creative dim sum tasting set.
redditQuotes: HongMian at The Westin stands out for its creative menu and stylish setting.

picks.name: Tai Ping Guan (太平馆)
picks.insiderTip: Since the 1860s. Unique East-meets-West heritage — try the Swiss-style chicken wings alongside traditional dim sum.
picks.whatToOrder: Swiss-style chicken wings, soufflé, traditional siu mai, roast pigeon.
redditQuotes: Tai Ping Guan is one of the oldest Western-style restaurants in Guangzhou with a unique historical perspective.
